cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: The course uses a point-based evaluation system. A student can earn a maximum of 100 points, with 40 points from exercises and 60 points from the exam. Points earned in exercises are included in the overall course evaluation. Conditions for obtaining credit for the course: Recognition of a project: business plan (max. 20 points) or a project focused on evaluating the financial situation of a selected enterprise (max. 20 points). Completion of at least two interim tasks, which will be carried out during the teaching part of the course (total max. 20 points). To be admitted to the exam, the student must obtain credit from the exercises. The exam is written in the form of test, open questions, and examples discussed in the course. To pass the exam, a minimum of 30 points is required. The minimum number of points for individual parts of the exam is not specified. Overall course evaluation: • Excellent (A) 90 - 100 points • Very Good Plus (B) 80 - 89 points • Very Good (C) 70 - 79 points • Good Plus (D) 60 - 69 points • Good (E) 50 - 59 points Detailed information on the individual points for course completion is provided to students during the first week of teaching and is also available on the course document server.
